name: kadasa

name: KartNGo

But a live online cart and 50k+ app installs (Gate 5b) could not be confirmed, leaving scale/digital-channel genuinely unresolved.

name: AlBaha Trading & Contracting Holding
note: A trading and contracting holding company (construction/contracting, Gate 2) with no consumer storefront of its own (Gate 4); domain dead and the Egyptian .eg domain shows no verifiable in-geography consumer retail arm.

name: عطور لوريس
note: Real Jeddah-based perfume retailer/agent (perfume approved, Saudi); audited domain is dead but the actual store lorisperfumeksa.com is live-but-'under maintenance,' so a live transactional cart (Gate 4) cannot be confirmed either way. Genuine ambiguity.

name: LSH ( Homaizi Group)
note: Kuwait holding company whose corporate domain is dead (Gate 4, holding page/no storefront) and whose portfolio mixes fashion/sports retail with food manufacturing (Al Homaizi Food Industries) and distribution, so the parent is excluded per Gate 6; a retail subsidiary such as Multitrend would need its own row.

name: Majestic Office Furniture
note: Live site is a B2B contract/project office-furniture supplier and manufacturer ('price on request,' no cart, sells to corporates/government/hotels) with no dedicated consumer retail arm. Fails Gate 2 (B2B/manufacturing) and Gate 4 even under the corrected hybrid clause.

name: LULU RAYYAN GROUP W.L.L
note: Live site sells construction/building materials, tools, plumbing/sanitary ware, welding and PPE; the retail category itself is Gate 2 hard-excluded (construction materials/hardware), so its wholesale-plus-retail-plus-ecommerce model does not rescue it.

name: Makkah Hypermarket Saudi Arabia
note: Real 25-year grocery/hypermarket chain with ~6 KSA stores (approved grocery category), so not a dead business; but HQ country is unclear (part of a 'KKH group' spanning Oman and KSA with 25 Oman stores) for Gate 1, and no own transactional e-commerce cart could be confirmed (offers distributed via a third-party flyer app) for Gate 4.

name: makeupforever
note: Site is live (original 'dead' reason wrong), a localized Make Up For Ever cosmetics store, but it is a foreign brand run by a regional operator serving UAE+Kuwait+Saudi from one platform (Chalhoub-type, Dubai-HQ'd). Fails Gate 1: the operating entity is not headquartered in Saudi Arabia.

name: Maraya
note: Real Saudi luxury-Arab-fashion e-commerce operating at shop.maraya.sa (approved fashion category, with customer service/returns/personal shopping and a Google Play app); apex maraya.sa returning 000 was an environment DNS false-negative, not a dead business. Gate 1/2/4 pass.

name: MATALAN Middle East

Audited hyphenated domain was dead but the relocated domain is live (Gate 4 rescue).

name: Al Mulla & Behbehani Motor Co.

name: moderncottagefurnitures

name: ITCO-International Timber Company
